messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary cluster redwood-api/canary-model-lb-1 error rate > 10% and p50 latency +80%. Pager routed to oncall. Link: https://graphs.internal/redwood/canary/3543216789

mike: Seeing 5xx spike and increased token latency. Traces point to model-quant-v2 handlers timing out.

sarah: That's the staged quant rollout, right? I thought `model_experiment_v2` was under a flag.

jordan: Correct, it was toggled at ~06:12. Metrics jumped ~06:18 after ramp. Need rollback/kill-switch.

tina: Oncall here. Initiating canary drain + flip feature flag to OFF. @deploy-bot please flip `model_experiment_v2` and start traffic reflow.

deploy-bot: Request received: toggle feature flag `model_experiment_v2` -> OFF. Applying to canary ring.

deploy-bot: Flag change applied to 2/2 canary nodes. Starting traffic shift away from quant-v2 to stable model (ops id: cb-3543216789).

mike: Running quick smoke against /generate — 3/3 success, p95 latency back to baseline. Still a few residual traces referencing quant-v2 KV errors but volume is low.

tina: Kicking manual rollback of canary images to stable tag `model:v1.12.4`. Command: ```kubectl -n inference set image deployment/canary model=registry/redwood/model:v1.12.4```

jordan: I'll run the prod-smoke suite and re-run evals for the top customer prompt sets. Also checking top-affected customers list.

deploy-bot: Rollback deployment started. Progressive rollout: 10% -> 100% over 4m. All new pods are Ready.

incident-bot: Note: Estimated 15% of requests between 06:18-06:24 reached quant-v2. Customer impact: small subset saw elevated 5xx and latency. Pager cleared at 06:24 after flag flip and rollback start.

sarah: :thumbsup: Can someone own the RCA and postmortem? Also add action items for flags.

tina: Creating ticket INC-354321 and assigning RCA to @jordan. I'll capture timeline, metrics, and mitigation steps in the postmortem template.

mike: Suggestion: add an auto-safe-mode that aborts canary ramps if unweighted latency increases >20% or 5xx > 2% within first 5m.

jordan: Agreed. Action items: add preflight smoke gating, stricter canary ramp policy, and automated kill-switch tests in CI. I'll include these in the RCA.

tina: Closing loop: traffic fully back on stable model as of 06:25. Monitoring window set to 30m. Oncall will watch for regressions and update INC-354321 with any fallout.
